                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/GuZhenYin/p/21447938" title="发布于 2026-07-16 09:02">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">零基础认识大语言模型（LLM）工作原理(14.Skill：为什么 Agent 可以拥有专业技能？)</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h1 class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="1royc8t" data-start="349" data-end="381">第十四章 Skill：为什么 Agent 可以拥有专业技能？</h1>
<h2 class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="1mpo7k2" data-start="613" data-end="633">目录</h2>
<p class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="1mpo7k2" data-start="613" data-end="633"><a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/GuZhenYin/p/20983335">零基础认识大语言模型（LLM）工作原理目录 - GuZhenYin - 博客园</a></p>
<h2 data-section-id="cxuaum" data-start="383" data-end="390">本章导读</h2>
<p data-start="392" data-end="409">上一章，我们介绍了 Memory。</p>
<p data-start="411" data-end="423">Memory 解决的是：<strong data-start="427" data-end="441">AI 如何记住信息。</strong></p>
<p data-start="443" data-end="472">但是，仅仅拥有记忆，还不足以让 AI 成为真正的专业助手。</p>
<p data-start="474" data-end="514">例如，一个刚毕业的程序员，即使记住了很多知识，也未必能够独立完成复杂的软件开发。</p>
<p data-start="516" data-end="521">原因在于：<strong data-start="525" data-end="556">知识（Knowledge）并不等于技能（Skill）。</strong></p>
<p data-start="558" data-end="609">同样，对于 Agent 来说，仅仅拥有大模型、Memory 和 Tool，还不足以解决复杂的专业任务。</p>
<p data-start="611" data-end="642">它还需要具备一种更高层次的能力——<strong data-start="628" data-end="641">Skill（技能）</strong>。</p>
<hr data-start="644" data-end="647">
<h1 data-section-id="1q05iqk" data-start="649" data-end="662">14.1 从知识到技能</h1>
<p data-start="664" data-end="673">举个生活中的例子</p>
<p data-start="675" data-end="682">假设有两个人</p>
<p data-start="684" data-end="688">第一位：刚刚考过驾照。</p>
<p data-start="699" data-end="703">他知道：</p>
<ul data-start="705" data-end="736">
<li data-section-id="55ydgk" data-start="705" data-end="712">红灯停车；</li>
<li data-section-id="1o11n9" data-start="713" data-end="720">绿灯通行；</li>
<li data-section-id="vd446o" data-start="721" data-end="728">如何倒车；</li>
<li data-section-id="vffw8k" data-start="729" data-end="736">如何并线。</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="738" data-end="745">这些都是知识。</p>
<p data-start="738" data-end="745">&nbsp;</p>
<p data-start="747" data-end="751">第二位：是一位开了十年的出租车司机。</p>
<p data-start="769" data-end="780">面对复杂路况，他却知道：</p>
<p data-start="782" data-end="791">什么时候提前变道；</p>
<p data-start="793" data-end="802">什么时候绕开拥堵；</p>
<p data-start="804" data-end="816">什么时候选择另一条路线。</p>
<p data-start="818" data-end="825">这些就是技能。</p>
<p data-start="827" data-end="832">可以发现：<strong data-start="836" data-end="876">技能，并不是简单地拥有更多知识，而是知道如何综合运用这些知识去完成目标。</strong></p>
<p data-start="878" data-end="892">对于 AI 来说，也是一样。</p>
<p data-start="894" data-end="905">LLM 拥有大量知识。</p>
<p data-start="907" data-end="910">但是,</p>
<p data-start="907" data-end="910">如何完成 Java Code Review？</p>
<p data-start="936" data-end="946">如何分析数据库性能？</p>
<p data-start="948" data-end="957">如何完成需求拆解？</p>
<p data-start="959" data-end="972">这些并不是模型天然就会的。</p>
<p data-start="974" data-end="984">它们需要被组织起来。</p>
<hr data-start="986" data-end="989">
<h1 data-section-id="1yywtqr" data-start="991" data-end="1010">14.2 Skill 到底是什么？</h1>
<p data-start="1012" data-end="1028">很多文章把 Skill 理解成：<strong>一个 Prompt。</strong></p>
<p data-start="1044" data-end="1061">这是早期 Agent 框架的做法。</p>
<p data-start="1063" data-end="1066">例如：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>你是一位 Java 专家……

请按照以下格式回答……</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="1109" data-end="1116">然后保存起来,以后重复使用。</p>
<p data-start="1127" data-end="1142">这就是早期所谓的 Skill。</p>
<p data-start="1144" data-end="1161">但是今天来看，这种定义已经过时了。</p>
<p data-start="1163" data-end="1188">在最新的现代 Agent 中，一个 Skill 通常包含：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>Skill

├── Role（角色）
├── Prompt（提示词）
├── Tool（工具）
├── Workflow（执行流程）
├── Memory（知识）
└── Output（输出规范）</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="1303" data-end="1308">也就是说<strong data-start="1312" data-end="1346">Skill 成为了一种完成特定任务的能力封装，而不是一段提示词。</strong></p>
<hr data-start="1348" data-end="1351">
<h1 data-section-id="1undzsz" data-start="1353" data-end="1372">14.3 为什么需要 Skill？</h1>
<p data-start="1374" data-end="1381">来看一个例子。</p>
<p data-start="1383" data-end="1388">用户输入：<strong>帮我 Review 这段 Java 代码。</strong></p>
<p data-start="1415" data-end="1426">如果没有 Skill。</p>
<p data-start="1428" data-end="1433">模型只能根据当前 Prompt 回答。</p>
<p data-start="1452" data-end="1454">而Java Review Skill：</p>
<p data-start="1476" data-end="1484">则可能会自动完成：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>读取代码
↓
分析代码规范
↓
检查空指针
↓
检查 SQL
↓
检查事务
↓
检查异常处理
↓
生成 Review 报告</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;用户看到的还是一句话。</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="1588" data-end="1591">但是Agent 已经调用了一整套能力。</p>
<hr data-start="1612" data-end="1615">
<h1 data-section-id="10un67l" data-start="1617" data-end="1643">14.4 Skill 与 Tool 有什么区别？</h1>
<p data-start="1645" data-end="1661">这是很多同学也容易混淆的问题。</p>
<p data-start="1663" data-end="1668">Tool回答的是：<strong data-start="1679" data-end="1689">我能做什么？</strong></p>
<p data-start="1691" data-end="1694">例如：</p>
<ul data-start="1696" data-end="1726">
<li data-section-id="5q0oop" data-start="1696" data-end="1704">查询数据库；</li>
<li data-section-id="1kalzf0" data-start="1705" data-end="1717">执行 Python；</li>
<li data-section-id="y1n93q" data-start="1718" data-end="1726">打开浏览器。</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="1728" data-end="1734">Skill回答的是：<strong data-start="1745" data-end="1765">为了完成某件事情，我应该怎么做？</strong></p>
<p data-start="1767" data-end="1770">例如：</p>
<p data-start="1772" data-end="1784">Code Review。</p>
<p data-start="1786" data-end="1792">它可能需要：</p>
<ul data-start="1794" data-end="1850">
<li data-section-id="1n8fa7l" data-start="1794" data-end="1805">Git Tool；</li>
<li data-section-id="1xcfjjh" data-start="1806" data-end="1818">File Tool；</li>
<li data-section-id="idbdc5" data-start="1819" data-end="1833">Search Tool；</li>
<li data-section-id="1l05bn3" data-start="1834" data-end="1850">Terminal Tool；</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="1852" data-end="1860">多个 Tool。</p>
<p data-start="1862" data-end="1865">因此Skill不是 Tool。</p>
<p data-start="1885" data-end="1888">而是<strong data-start="1892" data-end="1906">Tool 的组织者。</strong></p>
<hr data-start="1908" data-end="1911">
<h1 data-section-id="1vnmlir" data-start="1913" data-end="1944">14.5 Skill 与 Workflow 又有什么区别？</h1>
<p data-start="1946" data-end="1955">Workflow强调流程。</p>
<p data-start="1967" data-end="1970">例如：审批-&gt;报销-&gt;通知</p>
<p data-start="1987" data-end="1991">每一步都提前定义。</p>
<p data-start="2000" data-end="2006">Skill则强调能力。</p>
<p data-start="2018" data-end="2021">例如,SQL 优化、代码开发、需求分析。</p>
<p data-start="2046" data-end="2051">很多步骤其实需要模型自己决定。</p>
<p data-start="2064" data-end="2067">因此Workflow解决的是<strong data-start="2085" data-end="2094">流程固定</strong>问题<strong data-start="2085" data-end="2094">。</strong></p>
<p data-start="2096" data-end="2102">Skill则解决的是<strong data-start="2109" data-end="2120">专业能力复用</strong>问题<strong data-start="2109" data-end="2120">。</strong></p>
<hr data-start="2122" data-end="2125">
<h1 data-section-id="1gublvy" data-start="2127" data-end="2149">14.6 Skill 为什么越来越重要？</h1>
<p data-start="2151" data-end="2176">随着 Tool 数量越来越多，一个新的问题出现了。</p>
<p data-start="2178" data-end="2181">假设一个Agent 拥有300个tool</p>
<p data-start="2178" data-end="2181">那么,模型的每一次推理。</p>
<p data-start="2233" data-end="2241">是不是都要阅读 300 个 Tool Description(工具说明)？</p>
<p data-start="2268" data-end="2275">答案当然是:不是。</p>
<p data-start="2277" data-end="2280">因为如果这样,Prompt 会越来越长。</p>
<p data-start="2297" data-end="2304">推理就会越来越慢。</p>
<p data-start="2306" data-end="2314">准确率则会越来越低。</p>
<p data-start="2316" data-end="2319">于是,现代 Agent 开始采用<strong data-start="2339" data-end="2356">Skill 作为能力入口。</strong></p>
<p data-start="2358" data-end="2361">例如：Java Skill。</p>
<p data-start="2376" data-end="2379">里面再包含几十个 Tool。</p>
<p data-start="2398" data-end="2401">模型不用知道全部 Tool。</p>
<p data-start="2420" data-end="2426">只需要知道有Java Skill。</p>
<hr data-start="2441" data-end="2444">
<h1 data-section-id="1gseba" data-start="2446" data-end="2492">14.7 新一代 Skill：渐进式披露（Progressive Disclosure）</h1>
<p data-start="2494" data-end="2514">这是近期 Skill 设计最大的变化。</p>
<p data-start="2516" data-end="2530">早期 Agent 的做法是：</p>
<p data-start="2532" data-end="2536">启动时,把所有 Prompt,所有 Tool全部发送给模型。</p>
<p data-start="2571" data-end="2574">例如：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>Prompt+300 个 Tool+全部说明
↓
LLM</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="2628" data-end="2644">这样虽然简单，但有三个明显问题：</p>
<p data-start="2646" data-end="2694">第一，<strong data-start="2649" data-end="2663">上下文窗口被大量占用</strong>。很多 Token 都花在了工具说明上，而不是用户真正的问题。</p>
<p data-start="2696" data-end="2750">第二，<strong data-start="2699" data-end="2716">模型选择工具的难度越来越高</strong>。当几十甚至上百个工具同时出现时，模型容易误选，推理成本也随之增加。</p>
<p data-start="2752" data-end="2797">第三，<strong data-start="2755" data-end="2783">新增一个 Skill，就需要修改总 Prompt</strong>。系统规模越大，维护越困难。</p>
<p data-start="2799" data-end="2851">因此，新一代 Agent 普遍采用了<strong data-start="2817" data-end="2850">渐进式披露（Progressive Disclosure）</strong>。</p>
<p data-start="2853" data-end="2862">它的思想非常简单：<strong data-start="2866" data-end="2901">第一次，只告诉模型"有哪些能力"；真正需要时，再展开具体细节。</strong></p>
<p data-start="2903" data-end="2906">例如：</p>
<p data-start="2908" data-end="2920">最开始，模型看到的只是：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>可用 Skill：
- Java 开发
- Python 数据分析
- 数据库运维
- 文档写作</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="2985" data-end="2992">如果模型判断：<strong>当前任务属于 Java 开发。</strong></p>
<p data-start="3013" data-end="3028">Runtime 才会继续加载：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>Java Skill
↓
Prompt
↓
Workflow
↓
Tool List
↓
Memory</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="3103" data-end="3113">最后才开始真正执行。</p>
<p data-start="3115" data-end="3123">整个过程如下：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>用户请求
↓
LLM 判断需要哪个 Skill
↓
加载该 Skill
↓
继续推理
↓
如果需要 Tool
↓
继续加载 Tool 描述
↓
执行 Tool
↓
继续推理</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="3239" data-end="3253">请注意，这里有一个关键思想：<strong data-start="3257" data-end="3291">不是所有能力都需要提前暴露给模型，而是在需要的时候逐步揭示。</strong></p>
<p data-start="3293" data-end="3304">这就是所谓的"渐进式披露"。</p>
<hr data-start="3306" data-end="3309">
<h1 data-section-id="1sip8tr" data-start="3311" data-end="3331">14.8 为什么渐进式披露如此重要？</h1>
<p data-start="3333" data-end="3351">如果把 Agent 比作一位工程师。</p>
<p data-start="3353" data-end="3361">传统方式相当于我们每天上班,就要先阅读500 页员工手册,然后才开始工作。</p>
<p data-start="3400" data-end="3402">但是渐进式披露则更像,</p>
<p data-start="3400" data-end="3402">我如果需要写 SQL。</p>
<p data-start="3427" data-end="3436">才打开数据库文档。</p>
<p data-start="3438" data-end="3447">需要写 Java。</p>
<p data-start="3449" data-end="3461">才打开 Java 文档。</p>
<p data-start="3463" data-end="3466">这样工作效率更高。</p>
<p data-start="3477" data-end="3480">模型其实也是一样。</p>
<hr data-start="3489" data-end="3492">
<h1 data-section-id="12ygdjv" data-start="3494" data-end="3534">14.9 OpenClaw 与 Claude Code 的 Skill 思想</h1>
<p data-start="3536" data-end="3567">虽然不同产品实现方式不同，但近年来都逐渐体现出相同的设计趋势：</p>
<ul data-start="3569" data-end="3672">
<li data-section-id="146uy2r" data-start="3569" data-end="3593"><strong data-start="3571" data-end="3592">Skill 不再只是 Prompt</strong>；</li>
<li data-section-id="u8sm2n" data-start="3594" data-end="3616"><strong data-start="3596" data-end="3615">Skill 成为能力的组织单元</strong>；</li>
<li data-section-id="9qg2c8" data-start="3617" data-end="3641"><strong data-start="3619" data-end="3640">按需加载，而不是一次性加载全部能力</strong>；</li>
<li data-section-id="ymyxkr" data-start="3642" data-end="3672"><strong data-start="3644" data-end="3671">通过 Runtime 动态决定需要暴露哪些能力</strong>。</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="3674" data-end="3793">以 OpenClaw 为例，一个 Skill 可以组织 Prompt、Tool、Memory 等资源；而在 Claude Code 一类面向开发的 Agent 中，也会根据当前开发任务动态加载不同能力，而不是把所有开发规则一次性交给模型。</p>
<p data-start="3795" data-end="3837">这说明，Skill 正在从"提示词模板"演变为 Agent 的<strong data-start="3826" data-end="3836">能力管理机制</strong>。</p>
<hr data-start="3839" data-end="3842">
<h1 data-section-id="1k53e2t" data-start="3844" data-end="3867">14.10 一个相对完整的 Agent 架构</h1>
<p data-start="3869" data-end="3888">到这里，我们终于可以把前几章串起来了。</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>                 用户目标
                     │
                     ▼
              Agent Runtime
                     │
         ┌───────────┼───────────┐
         ▼           ▼           ▼
      Memory      Workflow     Skill Router
                                     │
                          选择合适的 Skill
                                     │
                                     ▼
                                 Skill
                         ┌──────┼──────┐
                         ▼      ▼      ▼
                      Prompt  Tool   Memory
                                     │
                                     ▼
                                    LLM</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="4574" data-end="4579">我们可以看到,<strong data-start="4581" data-end="4647">Skill 并不是替代 Prompt、Tool 或 Memory，而是把它们组织成一个可复用、可管理、可按需加载的能力模块。</strong></p>
<hr data-start="4649" data-end="4652">
<h1 data-section-id="1mm2zvm" data-start="4654" data-end="4660">本章总结</h1>
<p data-start="4662" data-end="4678">这一章，我们回答了五个关键问题：</p>
<ol data-start="4680" data-end="5032">
<li data-section-id="s3vphj" data-start="4680" data-end="4732"><strong data-start="4683" data-end="4697">Skill 是什么？</strong>
<ul data-start="4701" data-end="4732">
<li data-section-id="79fqe3" data-start="4701" data-end="4732">它不是一段 Prompt，而是一种完成特定任务的能力封装。</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-section-id="1fnn94c" data-start="4734" data-end="4793"><strong data-start="4737" data-end="4758">Skill 与 Tool 的区别？</strong>
<ul data-start="4762" data-end="4793">
<li data-section-id="1fbmmk7" data-start="4762" data-end="4793">Tool 提供单一能力，Skill 组织多个能力完成目标。</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-section-id="gy25dc" data-start="4795" data-end="4854"><strong data-start="4798" data-end="4823">Skill 与 Workflow 的区别？</strong>
<ul data-start="4827" data-end="4854">
<li data-section-id="owdcn5" data-start="4827" data-end="4854">Workflow 管流程，Skill 管专业能力。</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-section-id="e0a87u" data-start="4856" data-end="4946"><strong data-start="4859" data-end="4896">什么是渐进式披露（Progressive Disclosure）？</strong>
<ul data-start="4900" data-end="4946">
<li data-section-id="ac4yxy" data-start="4900" data-end="4946">不一次性暴露所有能力，而是在运行过程中按需加载 Skill、Prompt 和 Tool。</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-section-id="1e9cgjc" data-start="4948" data-end="5032"><strong data-start="4951" data-end="4974">为什么这是新一代 Agent 的趋势？</strong>
<ul data-start="4978" data-end="5032">
<li data-section-id="2awk08" data-start="4978" data-end="5032">它减少上下文占用、降低模型决策复杂度、提高系统可扩展性，也是大型 Agent 系统走向工程化的重要标志。</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>

</div>
